wiki.title: Phil Jensen
wiki.extract: Phil Jensen (born July 24, 1952), is an American politician from Pennington County, South Dakota who is a current member of the South Dakota House of Representatives and has served as a Republican member of the South Dakota Senate representing District 33 from 2013 to 2021. Jensen served consecutively in the South Dakota Legislature from January 2009 until January 8, 2013 in the South Dakota House of Representatives District 33 seat. He currently serves as the Chairman of the South Dakota Freedom Caucus. He supplements his legislative income as a cookware dealer.
